title: Option-Implied Signals and Crash Risk: Predictability and Machine-Learning Evidence from U.S. Equity Options
abstract: arXiv:2608.26115v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We re-estimate canonical option-implied predictability evidence using a unified 2015--2026 panel of 12.36 million U.S. equity firm-day observations across 10,026 underlyings. We split the sample into three regimes: late-post-crisis low volatility (2015--2019), high-volatility transition (2020--2022), and AI/mega-cap concentration (2023--2026). The Xing et al. (2010) smirk--return relationship weakens steadily: the next-month univariate smirk coefficient falls from $-0.023$ $(t=-5.5)$ in 2015--2019 to an insignificant $-0.006$ $(t=-1.5)$ in 2023--2026, and turns positive at the three-month horizon $(+0.016,\ t=+2.1)$. In joint specifications with all six canonical signals, the smirk is insignificant throughout and again changes sign in the latest regime. By contrast, the Cremers--Weinbaum IV spread and a Bakshi et al. (2003)-style risk-neutral skewness measure remain significant across regimes and specifications. A boosted-tree benchmark

translated_title: 期权隐含信号与崩盘风险：来自美国股票期权的可预测性与机器学习证据
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26115v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们使用一个统一的2015年至2026年面板数据，包含10,026个标的资产的1,236万美国股票公司日观测值，重新估计了经典的期权隐含可预测性证据。我们将样本分为三个时期：后危机晚期低波动期（2015-2019）、高波动过渡期（2020-2022）以及人工智能/大型市值集中期（2023-2026）。Xing等人（2010）的“ smirk”与收益关系逐渐减弱：下月单变量“ smirk”系数从2015-2019年的$-0.023$（$t=-5.5$）降至2023-2026年不显著的$-0.006$（$t=-1.5$），并在三个月期限上转为正值（$+0.016$，$t=+2.1$）。在包含所有六个经典信号的联合设定中，“ smirk”在所有时期均不显著，并在最新时期再次改变符号。相比之下，Cremers-Weinbaum隐含波动率价差和Bakshi等人（2003）风格的风险中性偏度指标在各时期和设定中保持显著。一个提升树基准模型...
tldr: 本文通过分析2015-2026年美国股票期权数据，发现经典的Xing等人（2010）偏度-收益关系在近期显著减弱甚至反转，而隐含波动率价差和风险中性偏度仍保持稳定的预测能力。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that the classic smirk-return relationship from Xing et al. (2010) weakens and even reverses in recent years (2023-2026), while implied volatility spread and risk-neutral skewness retain robust predictive power across regimes.
